enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Constitution +13: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Constitution +6: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Quality Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Constitution.

enchantments.tooltip: Profane Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Profane bonus to the DC of all spells.

Legendary Elemental Energy: Harnessing a small amount of power and potential of the raw elements, this item gives you a +150 bonus to your maximum spell points. This stacks with all bonuses except for Legendary Elemental Energy.
Spell Save +11: This item gives a +11 Resistance bonus to your saves versus spells.
Astute Alchemist: While wearing two pieces from the Astute Alchemist set, you gain:
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
